featured_reviews.name: Anuvhuti Bisht
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a regular client of Heads Up For Tails Spa, Colaba for my dog Alfie (goes by alfie.beinggolden on Instagram), so it’s safe to say that I have a bit of experience with them and I am also qualified to make an honest review here.

First of all, I’d like to thank our groomer, Sochipem, today. He did a brilliant job.

The staff is really lovely and they know what they are doing. They ask many questions from you to figure out your pet’s temperament, allergies (if any), concerns and requirements. Post the spa they give you a detailed feedback of everything they came across during the spa session and they even give you a report card with your dog’s physical health issues like rashes, dental and infections, so you get a nice picture of everything they have noticed during the bath. The only negative feedback I can give regards to the grooming is that they need a little bit more training on hair cutting. It’s only moderately okay.

The spa is inside a full fledged HUFT store so you know that you’ll get everything there to meet your pet’s needs. They have everything in every price bracket and affordability.

The HUFT store & spa stands in a prime location regard to connectivity, shoppers hub, food options.
So, while your pet is getting groomed, you can go to the causeway market to do some street shopping, or go to a restaurant/cafe to grab a quick meal, or just visit the gateway to reminisce (I mean, whatever floats your boat). I like to go to the leopold cafe and try a new dish off the menu each time.

So, all in all, Heads Up For Tails Stores & Spa, Colaba, will meet all your requirements. And you can take your pet out for their grooming while making a day out of it for yourself too.

Summary Review:
Grooming: 5/5
Hair Cutting: 4/5
HUFT Store: 5/5
Prices: 5/5
Staff: 5/5

featured_reviews.review_text:
The pet market in Mumbai, also known as Crawford Market, is a popular destination for pet lovers. The market offers a variety of pets for sale, including dogs, cats, birds, fish, and small animals like rabbits and guinea pigs.
While some visitors appreciate the variety of pets available at the market, others have expressed concerns about the welfare of the animals sold there. Some have reported seeing animals kept in cramped and unsanitary conditions, which can lead to health problems.
It's important to remember that pet ownership is a serious responsibility, and prospective pet owners should carefully consider their decision before purchasing an animal. It's also recommended to adopt from animal shelters or reputable breeders rather than purchasing from pet markets, to ensure that animals are well-cared for and treated ethically.

featured_reviews.name: Vielka Alphonso
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased a Shih Tzu puppy on 23/03/2026 from Zunjar Pet Shop, and this has been one of the worst and most heartbreaking experiences of my life.
The sales executive Salman emotionally pressures and misleads customers into buying puppies that are already sick. He makes false commitments at the time of sale and within just a few days, he completely denied knowing me or my pet. This is highly unprofessional and unethical.
I was not provided any vaccination records, certificates, or proper guidance. The puppy was already infected, and within just 4 days started showing serious symptoms like vomiting, diarrhea, lethargy, and gastro issues. Later, we also discovered ringworm infection, which clearly shows the poor hygiene and neglect at the shop.
The owners Bhagwan, Ajinkya, and Mohan are equally irresponsible and least bothered to address customer concerns. There is absolutely no accountability, no support, and no concern for the animals’ health.
Even more shocking:
The pets are kept in unclean and unhealthy cages
Wrong food guidance was given
My puppy stopped eating and drinking within days
Despite returning the puppy within 6 days due to critical health issues, NO REFUND was provided
Paying full amount and seeing the pet suffer within 7 days was something I never expected. This caused not only financial loss but emotional trauma for both me and the innocent puppy.
This is not just bad service — this is cruelty towards animals and cheating customers.
⚠️ I strongly urge everyone:
DO NOT buy pets, fish, or birds from this shop or any shop in Crawford Market.
They care only about money, not about the lives of innocent animals.
Absolutely FRAUD business. Worst experience ever. Not recommended at all. ❌

featured_reviews.review_text: These people are fraud ! I would say God will definitely punish these people with same illness ! We had purchased a kitten 1 week ago , she was only active for 5 days after that started vomiting , fever spike loose stools doctors are suspecting her With pan leukopenia also the doctor mentioned do not buy pets from Crawford as they sell such animals ! And now the shop keeper has the audacity to say that we do not take guarantee after selling ! Such a shameless people!

featured_reviews.name: Joel Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text: Recently got a german shepherd puppy from this seller on Dec 16, 2023. The same day he started vomiting and had diarrhoea, the puppy was already infected with parvo virus (Gastro). The puppy was on IV fluids for 10 days and medication and then we lost him. PLEASE DO NOT BUY PUPPIES FROM ANY CRAWFORD MARKETS. These puppies are 80% prone to parvo virus which is fatal especially if the puppy is very small.

featured_reviews.name: Huzaifa Merchant
featured_reviews.review_text:
We bought a kitten from this shop at Crawford Market (Zunjar Pets) and honestly, it has been the worst experience ever. While selling the kitten, the guy was all cooperative, but the moment we brought it home his attitude completely changed. He gave us the WRONG information about what food to feed the kitten. Even the vet said to continue with it because a sudden change could harm the kitten – and because of that, our poor kitten had to suffer and practically starve for 20 days.

On top of that, we recently discovered the kitten has a ringworm infection! When we tried calling the shop owner for help, he absolutely refused to cooperate. No concern, no support, nothing.

Please, never ever buy pets from Crawford Market, especially from Zunjar Pets. These people are only interested in money, not the animals’ wellbeing. If I could, I would give ZERO stars and drag them to court to shut them down permanently.

It’s always better to buy from a good, responsible breeder who actually cares for the animals instead of these so-called pet shops at Crawford Market. Trust me, the people selling there are the worst – don’t make the same mistake we did

Many of the animals looked sick, malnourished, and completely neglected. 90% of the animals here are infected with parvovirus. It’s heartbreaking to see a place like this still in business.

If you love animals, do NOT support this shop. These poor animals deserve better!

featured_reviews.name: Alay Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited this pet shop, and I was deeply disturbed by the conditions I witnessed. The store clearly prioritizes profit over the well-being of the animals they sell. Many of the cages were overcrowded and filthy, and the animals seemed stressed and neglected. It was heart-wrenching to see puppies and kittens locked in small, uncomfortable spaces with no room to move or play. In fact, 90% of their pets have been infect with parvovirus.

It was obvious that these animals were being treated as products rather than living beings deserving of care and respect. The store was only interested in turning a quick profit, rather than ensuring the health and happiness of the animals in their care.

The treatment of animals here is unacceptable, and I will not be returning or recommending this shop to anyone. There are plenty of other pet shops that prioritize the animals’ health and happiness—this one certainly does not.

featured_reviews.name: Fatima Attari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely disappointed with The Cat King.

I had booked a grooming appointment for my cat and paid a 100 booking fee in advance. Unfortunately, my cat fell ill on the day of the appointment and I had to rush to the vet. I even had a valid doctor’s prescription and was ready to share proof, yet the staff refused to either refund or even reschedule the appointment. The complete lack of empathy towards a sick pet was honestly shocking.

On top of that, booking appointments with them is unnecessarily difficult. They are extremely rigid with timings and never make any effort to accommodate customer preferences or help find suitable slots. It always feels like customers are expected to adjust entirely according to their convenience, with zero flexibility from their side.

For a business dealing with pets and pet parents, basic understanding and customer service should be expected — sadly, that is completely missing here. Definitely not an experience I would recommend.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Parmar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting a pet store owned by my childhood best friend, who, if I may say so myself, was quite the brat when we were young. However, I am delighted to report that my friend has grown into an enthusiastic and passionate animal lover who runs a pet store that truly cares for its animals.

From the moment I stepped into the store, I was struck by the cleanliness and orderliness of the place. The store was well-stocked with a wide variety of pet supplies, from food and toys to grooming products and accessories. The shelves were neatly arranged, and everything was clearly labeled, making it easy to find what I needed.

But what impressed me the most was the care and attention given to the animals in the store. The tanks and cages were spotless, and the animals were clearly well-cared for and happy. My friend and his staff were knowledgeable about each animal's needs, and they took the time to answer all of my questions.

I was also impressed by the store's commitment to animal welfare. My friend sources his animals from reputable breeders and rescue organizations, and he ensures that they receive proper care and nutrition. He also works with local animal shelters to help find homes for animals in need.

Overall, I was very impressed with my visit to my friend's pet store. It was clear that he is passionate about what he does and truly cares for the animals under his care. I would highly recommend this store to anyone looking for high-quality pet supplies and knowledgeable staff who genuinely care for animals.

I wish Shreenath, my best friend - all the success and hope that it continues to grow and flourish even more, providing the best care for animals and serving as a model for other pet stores to follow.

Best pet store here in Parle .
They are super sweet and kind & treat all furry babies with utmost love . Even if something that you want isn’t available they make sure they order it for you at the earliest at rates lesser than other pet stores .

featured_reviews.name: Nawaaz Kortiwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
I'm really happy with the service this pet store provides.
I was stranded on Mumbai Airport as the airlines I was travelling in denied my pets(two persian cats) into the flight as I had put both of them into a single cage.
So, at 6.30 am in the morning, I dialed almost all the pet stores nearby to see if they could help me get a pet cage. None did, except Kiara's Pet Store. Shree, the store owner, came to my rescue, at 7am in the morning to provide me with a pet bag, without any hesitation. Because of him, I was able to on-board my cats onto the flight and get to where I was headed.
A million thanks to him.
I recommend everyone to visit this store for your all pet needs. I'm sure your pets will be  treated with compassion and love.

featured_reviews.name: Sabyasachi Talukdar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We were looking for here all-inclusive pet shop that could deliver us products of our choice with a proper hands on. We were looking for jackets for a pet dog and although they were a lot of options online, we wished to physically examine the size and the quality and then go for the purchase.

The employees and Just Dogs were very helpful in choosing us the correct product and also showed us the sizes and assisted us in choosing the correct jacket as well. Along with that, the varieties of food that were available for the pets are also very good. They also gave samples of pet food for us to try for our pets.

Since you made the purchase on Christmas, we were also given a special discount. Along with that, there were more than helpful for providing us the means to get the items delivered in the cities where they were not present.

One of the things that I liked about this particular store was that there was a laser engraved tag for the pets, in which the price was inclusive of the laser etching.

Moreover, the arrangement of products in the shop was also very good, neat, tidy and organised.

Just Dogs Juhu is a one stop destination for parents who wish to purchase the best of products for their furry friends. I would highly recommend them to you.

featured_reviews.name: Salman Sameer Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a regular customer of Just Dog, but recently I am very disappointed with the service. The delivery partner is always humble, polite, and delivers directly to my address on time — I really respect his professionalism.

However, the person who takes orders over the phone is extremely unprofessional. This is not the first time he has delayed my order — it has happened multiple times. Recently, my sister placed an order for food packets (worth around ₹4000+) along with three packets of litter. The order taker assured us it would be sent with the delivery partner, but it was again delayed without any proper communication.

As a brand, Just Dog should ensure professional staff who value customers’ time and treat them with respect. With a big name, I expect better CRM, punctuality, and trained employees. Kindly take strict action against the person handling calls, because his behaviour is affecting your brand reputation.

Note if this happen again, I will going to start give negative reviews to all of my friend who were ordering to just dogs other stores

featured_reviews.name: Ansh Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: I have been a regular customer at just dogs for almost 3 years now and yet off late I have been experiencing so much delay in my appointments especially today, I had an appointment at 1.30 and it got delayed for an hour and thirty minutes and my dog, Casper was taken in at 3 pm, the management doesn't realize that us owners also have work to do and any delay of 15-20 minutes can be understandable but so much is not acceptable it's a waste of our time and as a company they aren't doing anything to manage the appointments and delay. Necessary measures need to be taken to resolve this issue or else if this continues then I personally wouldn't recommend anyone who wishes to get their dog groomed to come visit here and check for other better places with value for customer service and time.
